book.fantastikmod.note1.page1: This wandering trader tried to sell me some kind of moon flower from some kind of Moon Forest or Blue... I didn't even listen. For 5 emeralds, it's better to buy something useful than a glowing flower from some unknown forest.
book.fantastikmod.note2.page1: Recently a trader came and sold dragon fur for 20 EMERALDS... A really rare thing... But the price... It seems easier to go to the snows to search for it yourself than to buy enough for good armor.
book.fantastikmod.note3.page1: Kitsune... Extremely unusual foxes. They talk and even protect from monsters... I wonder where they came from? I heard from one traveler about some goddess, Inari I think she was called. They said it was she who sent the kitsune into the world. How true is this?
book.fantastikmod.note4.page1: At night there was a terrible howl and the clatter of hooves... Like horses, but not quite...
book.fantastikmod.note5.page1: And the end of all things will come when two brothers swallow the sun and moon... What was that traveler talking about?
book.fantastikmod.note6.page1: Such powerful creatures and they adore simple tofu? I thought that the stronger and older, and these foxes have lived here twice as long as me, the more sublime the needs would be... But that's how it happens.
book.fantastikmod.princess_notes.title: Princess Mirabella's Notes
book.fantastikmod.princess_notes.page1:
May 12
Such melancholy in the castle... My brother is always away training with the knights, father is immersed in his studies, and I am not even allowed to leave the castle walls... Why? Is there truly something so terrifying on our plains? Something more terrifying than the fire dragons our knights nearly eradicated from these lands?
book.fantastikmod.princess_notes.page2:
June 1
Today several travelers arrived at our palace. They turned out to be from the forests close to the north. They told us their forest had been cursed and now it is impossible to live there — the animals vanished and others appeared, and the plants began to glow with blue and azure colors. As proof, they gifted us flowers from their homeland... I have never seen such beautiful lilies... It truly glowed with a faint light... Father allowed them to stay in the palace as servants.
book.fantastikmod.princess_notes.page3:
June 5
I have thought about this a lot... These are not the first people to arrive from other lands. Last year, people also came from the cherry groves. Their lands were not cursed, but I was never told the reason they left their homes.

July 13
The annual summer festival has been cancelled... I am so upset... I had even devised a plan with the maid to sneak out of the castle unnoticed by father and brother to attend it...
book.fantastikmod.king_notes.title: King Waldemar's Notes
book.fantastikmod.king_notes.page1:
May 1
It seems that near our lands, there are no longer any of those great fire lizards. This is very good...
book.fantastikmod.king_notes.page2:
May 15
Dragons, it turns out, are not our greatest problem. In past years there were rumors of an unknown new disease, and this year people arrived from another country with news of a curse upon their lands... In our lands it is quiet for now, but how long will this silence last? We must be prepared...
book.fantastikmod.king_notes.page3:
June 10
We did not eradicate them all... One of the dragons was spotted near one of the cities... Fortunately it did not attack, but it was flying toward the capital. We will have to cancel the festival and begin preparations for a possible battle. This will be harder than eradicating them in winter during their hibernation.
book.fantastikmod.dragon_scholar_notes.p:
Entry 1
Fire dragons are large lizard-like creatures with wings and horns on their heads. As the name suggests, they are capable of breathing flame from their maws and radiate a great amount of heat around themselves. The colors of specimens observed so far were shades of red and black.

Entry 2
These dragons lead a solitary life. Their nests are located far from one another, and two specimens were practically never observed at the same time.

Entry 3
Surprisingly, despite their inner heat, they hibernate in winter, hiding in narrow caves and emerging only in spring... Quite useful information.

Entry 4
Dragons are predators. In one nest, where I miraculously managed to visit and leave unnoticed, many bones and other inedible remains of animals were found.

dialog.kitsune_statue.line1: It seems you've found a fox statue
dialog.kitsune_statue.line2: People made these and placed them in temples as messengers of the goddess Inari
dialog.kitsune_statue.line3: They believed that making offerings to statues could win the favor of kitsune
dialog.kitsune_statue.line4: And they would stand before the goddess on the side of the one making offerings
dialog.kitsune_statue.line5: Rice and sake were often offered to the statues
dialog.kitsune_statue.line6: We have no need for rice. But you can try giving it to the statue
dialog.moon_deer_statue.line1: Is this someone's statue? A deity or a beast?
dialog.moon_deer_statue.line2: Many years ago, people lived in the Moon Forest, they believed in their gods
dialog.moon_deer_statue.line3: They had similar statues for their deities, but the people left with a fallen shard of the moon...
dialog.moon_deer_statue.line4: Almost nothing remains of the statues

quest.moondeer.tamed.complete: Thank you, here is your reward
dialog.wild_moon_deer.who_are_you: I am the spirit of this forest. Part of this forest that has guarded its peace for centuries
dialog.wild_moon_deer.about_place: This place was born from a shard of the moon. Once, Hati bit off a piece of the luminary shining with blue light, it fell to the earth and gave birth to this forest filled with the powers of the moon
dialog.wild_moon_deer.who_haiti: Hati is one of two brothers who pursues the moon every night, wanting to devour it
dialog.wild_moon_deer.about_brothers: Two brothers - Hati and Skoll. One chases the moon, the other - the sun. Both thirst to consume the luminaries
dialog.wild_moon_deer.if_eat_moon: If he eats the moon... something terrible will happen. But I, as a spirit confined to this place, cannot know all the secrets of the universe. You should ask him yourself.
dialog.wild_moon_deer.ask_bored: Boredom? Spirits perceive the world differently than humans. What is boredom for you is life for us
dialog.wild_moon_deer.ask_leave: Leave the forest? Over all these centuries, I have never thought about it. This forest is my home, my homeland... And the world beyond... What is it like?
dialog.wild_moon_deer.ask_join: Follow you? I cannot exist far from this forest. The lunar magic that flows in these lands gives me life
dialog.wild_moon_deer.how_to_tame: If you had an amulet created from a piece of the forest... Then I could follow you and a part of the forest would always be with me
dialog.wild_moon_deer.farewell: May the moonlight protect you on your path...
dialog.wild_moon_deer.where_haiti: He hasn't been seen for a long time... But before, he spent his days in this forest, sleeping in caves while the sun was shining. Now though... Perhaps he hides in the darkest corners of this world
dialog.wild_moon_deer.is_dangerous: He never touched us spirits... But you, humans... Rarely does anyone enter the forest, and even more rarely does someone find Hati... Perhaps you're right and he might be dangerous.
dialog.wild_moon_deer.how_know: Beyond the forest there must be those who know. Those same ones told us and the winds part of the legend...
dialog.moon_deer.greeting: Did you want to ask something, traveler?
dialog.moon_deer.outside_world: The world beyond the forest... It's unusual. So many new things. Probably, as humans would say - curious.
dialog.moon_deer.feelings: I feel... If measured by human standards, then normal? Everything is fine, thank you for asking.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.wild_feed.2: Nice to meet a friendly traveler.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.wild_feed.3: I don't often take food from strangers.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.wild_feed.4: Thank you. The forest shares its gifts with everyone.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.tamed_heal.4: Thanks, now I'm full of energy again.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.tamed_heal.5: It's nice to be taken care of.
My strength is restored. Lunar magic already flows through me fully.
I don't need healing. The forest spirits have already granted me their protection.
Thank you for your care, but moonlight already fills me with energy.
My health is fine. The power of the ancient forest protects me.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.tamed.0: Now I can accompany you on your journey.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.tamed.1: Now you can show me those lands you mentioned.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.tamed.2: The Moon Amulet... Now I am free to follow you.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.tamed.3: The forest spirits bless our meeting. I shall be your companion.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.tamed.4: You have earned my trust. I will be your faithful companion.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.tamed.5: The power of the moon has bound us. Now we journey together.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.death.0: The spirit of the Moon Deer has returned to its homeland...
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.death.1: The Moon Deer returns to the sacred forest...
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.death.2: The deer's spirit dissolves into the moonlight...
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.death.3: The forest guardian has completed its journey...
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_wild.0: Why? I haven't done anything to you.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_wild.1: You're disturbing the peace of the forest.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_wild.2: The forest doesn't forgive such actions.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_wild.3: I'm just a spirit of this place. Why cause me pain?
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_wild.4: You're a foreigner, but that's no reason for cruelty.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_wild.5: The forest world is fragile. Don't destroy it.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_tamed.0: I thought we were companions on this journey...
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_tamed.1: Why hurt someone who trusts you?
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_tamed.3: Pain from a companion's hand hurts more.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_tamed.4: I left the forest for our path. Don't betray that.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.hurt_tamed.5: This is not the path we chose together.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.naming.0: "%s"... I have a name for the first time. Thank you for giving it to me.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.naming.1: The name %s... It sounds like a whisper of moonlight. I will remember it.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.naming.2: %s? This is what I shall be called from now on... Thank you for this gift.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.naming.3: I never thought I would have a name. %s - a wonderful choice.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.naming.4: In the forest, we had no names. %s - is my first name. Thank you.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.naming.5: The name %s... It fills me with new strength. Thank you, companion.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.naming.6: In all my long life in the forest, I had no name. %s - is a new beginning.
chat.fantastikmod.moon_deer.naming.7: The moon spirits whisper that the name %s suits me. I thank you.
dialog.wild_kitsune.greeting: Greetings traveler, did you want to ask something?
dialog.wild_kitsune.who_are_you: I'm a kitsune, maybe you've already heard about us
dialog.wild_kitsune.can_talk: Of course I can! Or did you think I was an ordinary fox?
dialog.wild_kitsune.activities: Doing something. Walking, wandering here and there. Attacking monsters... The usual routine
dialog.wild_kitsune.ask_monsters: Yes, and are you going to doubt my abilities? You know, I could set you on fire for testing. Want to?
dialog.wild_kitsune.test_fire: There! Next time think before you speak. Unless you want my threats to be more than just words
dialog.wild_kitsune.ask_follow: Follow? With you? Where and why? I'm fine here actually
dialog.wild_kitsune.why_follow: Still, why would I need that? Although... If you provide me with tofu for all the time I'm with you, then I might as well go with you on your travels.
dialog.wild_kitsune.tofu_serious: Well, it's rarely found around here, and I really love it... Hmm... Everyone has their own values, understand?
dialog.wild_kitsune.how_much_tofu: A lot! Preferably a hundred, but I'll make a discount... Let me think... Well, from 20+ tofu I'll consider your offer
dialog.wild_kitsune.too_much: Hey! I actually gave you a discount! And not a small one! That's the final price!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.feed.3: I've never tasted tofu like this!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.feed.4: You know how to make me happy.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.feed.5: I hope you saved some more?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.feed.6: I'll never say no to tofu!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.tamed.0: I suppose I'll accompany you on your adventures.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.tamed.1: From now on, I follow you, wanderer.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.tamed.2: Very well, I shall be your companion.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.tamed.3: You have earned my trust. I'm with you.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.death.1: Your kitsune companion has passed away...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.death.2: The kitsune has breathed its last.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.death.3: Your faithful friend has left this world.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.hurt.0: Hey, it's not polite to hit strangers!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.hurt.1: Ouch! Are we really that close already?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.hurt.2: Didn't expect such a rude greeting...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.hurt.3: There are more civilized ways to introduce yourself!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.hurt.4: What an unpleasant surprise... I haven't done anything to you.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.hurt.5: I didn't think our meeting would start with a punch...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.hurt.6: Now that's what I call an unexpected compliment!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.wakeup.0: Morning already? I feel like I only slept a couple minutes...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.wakeup.1: I dreamed I became a great celestial fox... Why disturb me?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.wakeup.2: Ouch! I just lay down... You always know when to wake me.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.wakeup.3: You always know when to wake me at the most interesting part of my dream...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.wakeup.4: Did I really fall asleep so deeply? Feels like an eternity passed...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.wakeup.5: I think I slept through everything... Thanks for waking me up!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.wakeup.6: I fell so deeply asleep, I almost got lost in my dreams...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.wakeup.7: It was so nice to sleep... Too bad all good things must end.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry.0: That's it! You asked for a fight!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry.1: Hitting me twice for no reason? Now you'll get what you deserve!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry.2: Well, since you insist... Take this!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry.3: I warned you! Don't complain about the consequences now.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry.4: Alright, game on! Let's see who's tougher...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry.5: You crossed the line! I won't hold back anymore!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry.6: Two warnings are enough. Prepare for battle!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.owner_hurt.1: That hurts! Is this how you treat friends?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.owner_hurt.2: Hey, I'm on your side, remember?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.owner_hurt.3: In every blow - a broken piece of trust...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.owner_hurt.4: I remember when you gave me tofu, and now... this?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry_tofu.0: Without fresh tofu, I won't even listen to you!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry_tofu.1: Hmph! Only the most delicate tofu can heal my heart... Nothing else!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry_tofu.2: You hurt not only me but our bond... Tofu can fix everything, but not immediately.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry_tofu.3: I'll accept your apology... in the form of tofu. No other way!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.angry_tofu.4: My fox pride is wounded! It will take special tofu to heal it.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.forgive.0: Okay... I forgive you. But don't do it again!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.forgive.1: This tofu is as delicate as it should be... I forgive you.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.forgive.2: My fox pride softens... You've redeemed yourself.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.forgive.4: You remember what's important to me... That means a lot. I forgive you.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.forgive.5: How nice to be understood... Thank you for the tofu and apologies.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.name_reject_ta: My name was given, not changed.
I wear this name with pride, why change it?
This name has become part of my soul.
I was named this way for a reason.
I've grown accustomed to this name.
Let things remain as they are.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.name_reject_wi: You have no right to name me.
My name is known only to the wind and moon.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.idle.0: Bored? You could give me some tofu.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.idle.1: How old do you think I am? Hehe.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.idle.2: It's nice weather for a walk today.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.idle.4: You know, I like you more than the others.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.idle.5: I wonder what the goddess Inari is doing now?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.laugh.2: I can't stop! This is too funny!
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.owner_kill.0: You betrayed my trust, human... I don't want to see you anymore.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.owner_kill.1: I'm leaving you, from now on our paths diverge...
dialog.kitsune_light.greeting: Did you want to ask something?
dialog.kitsune_light.ask_missed: I always find something to do, so no. Although I missed your tofu...
dialog.kitsune_light.ask_activities: Sleeping, wandering... Are you really interested in what a kitsune does in her free time?
dialog.kitsune_light.ask_legend: Do you want to hear a legend about kitsune?
dialog.kitsune_light.ask_personal: Do you want to hear my story?
dialog.kitsune_light.random_legend: What legend can I tell you, human?
dialog.kitsune_light.random_story: What story about myself can I tell you?
dialog.kitsune_light.personal1: Once I was an ordinary fox and one day I was granted special powers... Hee-hee, just kidding. I just grew up and learned
dialog.kitsune_light.personal2: You know, every kitsune has the opportunity to grow a new tail? To do this, she must be strong or live another hundred years
dialog.kitsune_light.personal3: We kitsune love to play with travelers. Sometimes we take the form of beautiful women, sometimes old men. But with you I decided to be myself - that's much more interesting!
dialog.kitsune_light.personal4: My favorite pastime is teasing overconfident samurai. Once I made a whole squad search for a non-existent treasure for three days! And then they were looking for their katanas because all this time they were walking with ordinary sticks! Hee-hee!
dialog.kitsune_light.personal5: Tofu... Mmm... I remember the first time I tried it. It was in a small village at the foot of the mountain. Since then it's been my weakness!
dialog.kitsune_light.personal6: We kitsune live very long lives. I've seen how the seasons change, how people are born and return to the earth at sunset of life...
dialog.kitsune_light.story1_response: Maybe. Or maybe not. That's a little secret
dialog.kitsune_light.story2_response: The longest living kitsune have 9 tails. Someday I'll have that many too!
dialog.kitsune_light.story3_response: I can! Don't doubt my skills! Or next time in the village you'll have to be more careful when trading with the locals
dialog.kitsune_light.story4_response: Yes! I clouded their minds a bit and they thought the sticks were their katanas! Too bad no one met them on the way, it would have been funny to watch them fight with that
dialog.kitsune_light.story5_response: You're the ordinary one! I don't tell you that your diamonds are ordinary glass, do I? I have my values, you have yours
dialog.kitsune_light.story6_response: Me? And sad? Of course not! But... Be careful on your journey and come back
dialog.kitsune_light.legend1: They say that a nine-tailed kitsune has such power that she could turn into a second moon, illuminating the night with her silvery light when the real moon hid behind the clouds.
dialog.kitsune_light.legend2: According to ancient legends, kitsune serve the goddess of fertility and prosperity Inari. They guard shrines and punish those who steal rice or desecrate temples.
dialog.kitsune_light.legend3: Legend has it that kitsune can create illusions of entire cities. Travelers caught in such illusions can wander for days without realizing that everything around is just magic.
dialog.kitsune_light.legend4: Old stories tell of kitsune who fell in love with mortals. But such unions rarely ended happily - because people age, while kitsune live for centuries.
dialog.kitsune_light.legend5: They say that kitsune keep special pearls. Maybe you've already encountered such from wandering merchants or in the grass?
dialog.kitsune_light.legend6: According to legend, the wisest kitsune can predict the future. But they rarely share their predictions, for knowledge of the future can change destiny.
dialog.kitsune_light.legend1_response: When I grow 8 more tails, then I'll be able to
dialog.kitsune_light.legend2_response: That, my friend, is a secret
dialog.kitsune_light.legend3_response: That's why you shouldn't anger a kitsune!
dialog.kitsune_light.legend4_followup: You feed me tofu, why not?
dialog.kitsune_light.legend5_response: Pearls or a precious stone... Or maybe just a piece of glass. People believe it's something special, but whether it really is or not — they don't necessarily need to know
dialog.kitsune_light.legend6_response: I predict... That right now you'll give me lots of tofu!
dialog.kitsune_light.legend6_serious: But seriously, you can't know the future. And that's a legend. Legends aren't always true. Or maybe I can... Hee-hee. Someday the secret will be revealed
dialog.kitsune_light.legend6_silent: You won't give... Yes... This time my predictive skills failed me...
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.not_ow: Why should I listen to you?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.dog.0: I'm a kitsune, not a dog
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.dog.1: Get a dog and command it.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.dog.2: Do I look like a dog to you?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.dog.3: Should I bring your slippers too?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.dog.5: You've clearly mistaken me for someone else.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.dog.6: I decide what to do myself.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.help.3: Save you? From what? Your lack of manners?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.rescue: Fine, I'll save you. But only because you asked politely.
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.command.here_m: We're here! Did you lose us?
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.gre: Where did you find that mask?
dialog.player.kitsune1tail.soulmask.answ: How did you know I have it?
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.ans: The one in your inventory. The one that's most likely white with patterns
I haven't lived for just a year in this world! I know and sense many things!
Because you humans always grab things that look unusual and never think about the consequences
dialog.player.kitsune1tail.soulmask.what: And what's so special about it?
dialog.player.kitsune1tail.soulmask.how_: And how did you find out?
dialog.player.kitsune1tail.soulmask.norm: Looks ordinary to me, nothing special about it
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.wha: Nothing unusual! Or didn't you notice?
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.ama: Right, right! Keep being amazed by us! We're capable of many things! But you'd better leave the mask... Or give it to me! I'll find a use for it
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.not: Ordinary? You really don't see anything? Oh... What a fool! That's exactly why such masks exist — because there are fools like you!
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.wha: Many things! And not always good ones! You'd better give it to me!
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.nor: You're the ordinary one! And the things you find aren't always what they seem! Maybe some witch cursed them?
dialog.player.kitsune1tail.soulmask.why_: So why do you need it?
dialog.player.kitsune1tail.soulmask.dont: Don't call me names! Just tell me what's wrong with it!
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.say: M... Straight to the point... This mask is cursed. That's what. Give it to me and I'll put it away
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.why: Maybe I need it... M... So, will you give it or not?
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.don: Maybe I need it... M... So, will you give it or not?
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.wit: Maybe I need it... M... So, will you give it or not?
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.rea: Maybe I need it... M... So, will you give it or not?
dialog.player.kitsune1tail.soulmask.what: And what kind of curse is it?
dialog.kitsune.kitsune1tail.soulmask.cur: It's not yet time for you to know about such things... So, will you give it or not?
chat.fantastikmod.kitsune.mask.returned: I'm back! Here, a gift for you in exchange for the mask
message.fantastikmod.kitsune.upset: Kitsune is too upset to talk
message.fantastikmod.kitsune.asleep_hint: Kitsune is asleep, you should wake her up if you need anything
dialog.bakeneko.greeting: Hmm... A human? Well, hello. Say what you need and quickly, I have many cat things to do
dialog.bakeneko.answer_who: Humans are supposed to be smart, but you say stupid things. Can't you see by my tail and ears? How often do dogs purr or squirrels meow?
dialog.bakeneko.answer_business: You humans cannot understand the importance of our business!
dialog.bakeneko.answer_follow: You have food... Isn't that obvious? Share, little human!
dialog.bakeneko.answer_steal: Me? Steal? How dare you accuse me!? I only took what was lying alone waiting for my appearance!
dialog.bakeneko.answer_who_1: I'm a cat, not some beast! A Bakeneko cat! Remember that for the future
dialog.bakeneko.answer_who_2: When humans started asking stupid questions
dialog.bakeneko.answer_business_2: How rude! This is a very important matter!
dialog.player.ask_bakeneko_business: What business? Weren't you just sleeping?
dialog.player.ask_bakeneko_steal: Who allowed you to steal from my chest?!
dialog.player.ask_bakeneko_who_2: When did cats learn to walk on their hind legs?
dialog.player.ask_bakeneko_business_2: I don't think sleeping is such an important matter
dialog.player.ask_bakeneko_steal_2: I know perfectly well it was you!
dialog.player.ask_bakeneko_steal_3: Okay... If it wasn't you, then it wasn't. There was nothing important there anyway
chat.bakeneko.stole_from_player: Bakeneko stole something from your chest!
chat.bakeneko.stolen_from_bakeneko: You took an item from Bakeneko
chat.fantastikmod.bakeneko.hurt.7: That's not how you pet a cat!
dialog.player.ask_if_eat: What happens if he eats the moon?
dialog.player.ask_leave: Do you want to leave this forest?
dialog.player.ask_join: Would you like to come with me?
dialog.player.ask_outside_world: How do you like the world outside?
dialog.player.ask_how_know: And how to find out then?
dialog.player.ask_kitsune_light_story1: Do you gain powers with age?
dialog.player.ask_kitsune_light_story2: And how many tails can there be?
dialog.player.ask_kitsune_light_story3: Or you just can't change your appearance?
dialog.player.ask_why_follow: Come with me on a journey
dialog.player.ask_how_much_tofu: And how much do you need?
dialog.fantastikmod.drying.teamaster.1: To make tea, it's not enough to collect tea leaves and pour boiling water over them
dialog.fantastikmod.drying.teamaster.2: You first need to dry them and only then enjoy the taste of green tea
dialog.fantastikmod.drying.kitsune.2: In the east, they do. They even hold tea ceremonies among the nobility
dialog.fantastikmod.drying.kitsune.3: I heard from an older kitsune who lived among people
dialog.fantastikmod.drying.kitsune.4: I've only seen how tea was dried in such baskets
dialog.fantastikmod.drying.moon_deer.2: Do people store something in them?
